title: Havkelaag's Key
summary: Unlocks the wooden chest in the attic of the Lodge.

fields.Acquisition: Carried by Havkelaag. The chest holds gold and alchemy ingredients. DC 15 Sleight of Hand is an alternative.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
